title: Easy to assemble, but disproportionate in size
text: Easy to assemble, but disproportionate in size. It was SUPER easy to assemble, however, it’s not the correct size. We ordered a California King because that’s the size mattress we have. The frame is too short width wise as the mattress hangs over BOTH sides and it’s too long lengthwise as the mattress doesn’t reach both the top and bottom. And yes, I tried turning the mattress, I have it on correctly. It’s sturdy, and I do slew better with this support, but it’s very frustrating that the size is completely off for what I needed.
